sentence: The feather was a falcon's. Apollo 15's lunar module was named Falcon.
claim: The feather Scott dropped was a falcon feather, and Apollo 15's lunar module was named Falcon.
source_title: NASA NSSDCA, The Apollo 15 Hammer-Feather Drop; and NASA NSSDCA, Apollo 15 mission page (https://nssdc.gsfc.nasa.gov/planetary/lunar/apollo15info.html)
note: End-card footnote (on screen, not spoken). Excerpts: 'a light object (a 0.03-kg* falcon feather)' (NASA, c3); the drop happened 'near the LM Falcon' at Hadley Rille/Apennines (NASA's Apollo 15 page).
